title: Pip and the Sleepy Cloud
description: A little bear helps a tired rain cloud find a cozy place to rest before it can rain.
character_reference: a small brown bear cub with patched fuzzy ears and a cream-colored belly

scenes.narration: A fluffy little gray cloud drifted right down into Pip's treehouse balcony, looking completely exhausted. It was too tired to float back up to the big sky.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a small brown bear cub looking surprised at a soft fluffy gray cloud resting on his wooden porch railing

scenes.narration: Oh dear, whispered Pip. You look like you need a wonderful nap. The cloud let out a sleepy puff of cool mist that felt like a refreshing morning breeze.
scenes.visual: close up of the cute bear cub gently patting the top of a fluffy floating vapor cloud with a kind expression

scenes.narration: Pip fetched his softest spare quilt and tucked it gently around the puffy gray shape. The cloud sighed happily and turned the color of spun cotton candy.
scenes.visual: wide shot of the bear cub carefully draping a colorful patched blanket over a puffy cloud resting on a wooden deck

scenes.narration: While the cloud slept, tiny drops of gentle rain sprinkled down just enough to water Pip's thirsty tomato plants in the garden below. It was the happiest nap ever.
scenes.visual: low angle shot looking up past green leaves as tiny sparkling raindrops fall softly from the resting cloud above

scenes.narration: When the cloud woke up, it felt light and bouncy again, ready to float back up to join its fluffy family in the bright blue sky.
scenes.visual: medium shot of the bear waving goodbye as the puffy cloud rises slowly into the air trailing sparkling mist

scenes.narration: The cloud left behind a sparkling rainbow bridge as a special thank-you gift for its good friend. Pip smiled up at the sky and felt ready for bed.
scenes.visual: close up of the bear cub smiling warmly while looking up at a colorful pastel rainbow arching across the twilight sky

scenes.narration: A little kindness makes the whole world feel bright and warm. Follow along for more bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: calming view of a pastel twilight sky with twinkling stars beginning to appear through soft clouds
